subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Has Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer been published and verified through all supported install channels, and should this fail-closed cloud-worker upgrade land after a fresh current-main refresh?
rationale: The code review cannot establish deployment readiness because the patch intentionally depends on an external runtime version that the discussion says is not yet available through supported channels.

options.title: Hold for verified release
options.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer, verify supported-channel fresh installs and upgrades, refresh the branch, and merge only after exact-head proof passes.

options.title: Accept temporary AWS outage risk
options.body: Merge before channel propagation and explicitly accept that AWS cloud workers using the supported v0.38.0 installation may fail closed.

recommendation.title: Hold for verified release
recommendation.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer, verify supported-channel fresh installs and upgrades, refresh the branch, and merge only after exact-head proof passes.

likelyOwner.reason: Coordinates both this cloud-worker series and the stated Crabbox release prerequisite.
